$comment: Hydrogen (#83): `context.storefront.query(document, { variables })` and `mutate` send to the Storefront API of the store `createStorefrontClient({ storeDomain })` (or `createHydrogenContext`) was given, at `{shop}.myshopify.com/api/{version}/graphql.json`; `context.customerAccount.query(...)` to the Customer Account API at `shopify.com/{shopId}/account/customer/api/{version}/graphql`. Route handlers get these clients from the request's context, not from an import: in a project whose manifests declare Hydrogen, a `storefront` or `customerAccount` value's `query` / `mutate` is the client's (`contextClients`); elsewhere the names say nothing (`callersOnly`).
